name: Quay of the Tiber
source:
Two girls went down the steps of the embankment to the Tiber to make beautiful photos of the Castle of St. Angel. They laughed, admired the reflection of the castle in the water, the play of light and silence. It seemed that Rome remained somewhere on the surface. The sounds of cars passing along the embankment and the voices of people were heard as if from afar. Girls slowly moved along the river and suddenly noticed that under the bridge stirred some shadow....

[From [url=https://itcherbaka.itch.io/quayofthetiber] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩沿着堤岸的台阶走到台伯河边，为圣天使城堡拍摄美丽的照片。他们哈哈大笑，欣赏城堡在水中的倒影、光与静的变化。罗马似乎还停留在地表的某个地方。路堤上汽车行驶的声音和人们的说话声仿佛从很远的地方传来。女孩们沿着河慢慢前行，突然发现桥下搅动着一些影子……
